description: Add one AND entry gate. Args: side + condition JSON. You are the DSL translator. Invent the section JSON (condition/position/exit/cooldown). Browser applies only — BenAwf does not call an LLM. No prose text.

field.description: Bar field: open, high, low, or close (default close). Ignored at `lookback: 0` (live ticker). At `lookback >= 1` returns this OHLC field of bar N back — enables wick/rejection patterns (e.g. high pierced a level then close reclaimed).

lookback.description: How many bars back to look. 0 = latest bar, 1 = one bar ago, etc. Max 20.

timeframeMinutes.description: Chart timeframe (5, 15, 60, 240, or 1440 minutes) the lookback resolves against. `lookback: 0` returns the live ticker price (timeframe-independent); `lookback >= 1` returns the chosen `field` of bar N back on this timeframe.

field.description: Sub-field for composite indicators: MACD uses signal/histogram, BBANDS uses upper/middle/lower, VOLUME_PROFILE uses poc/vah/val, DEALING_RANGE uses equilibrium/premium_pct. Use value for scalar indicators.

name.description: Indicator name. One of: SMA20, SMA50, EMA, RSI, ADX, MACD, BBANDS, ATR, ATR_PCT, VWAP, OBV, OBV_CHANGE, LAST_DAY_HIGH, LAST_DAY_LOW, LAST_WEEK_HIGH, LAST_WEEK_LOW, SWING_HIGH, SWING_LOW, BOS, CHOCH, DISPLACEMENT, VOLUME_PROFILE, DEALING_RANGE.

params.description: Optional indicator parameters (e.g. swing pivot wing, VOLUME_PROFILE lookbackBars). Empty object = defaults.

atrMult.description: ATR(14) multiplier for DISPLACEMENT: bar range must exceed atrMult × ATR to count as displacement. Default 1.5.

lookbackBars.description: Rolling window length for VOLUME_PROFILE (bars ending at the current closed bar). Default 48. Must fit the entry-rules indicator window (≤100).

wing.description: Pivot wing for SWING_HIGH/SWING_LOW/BOS/CHOCH/DEALING_RANGE: bars required on each side to confirm a pivot. Default 3. Smaller (1–2) = short-term structure, larger (4–10) = major swings only.

field.description: Zone price level: top or bottom edge, or mid (midpoint — the FVG 'consequent encroachment'). Default mid.

state.description: Which zones to consider: open = untouched, tapped = wick entered but no close through, mitigated = closed beyond the far edge. Default open.

timeframeMinutes.description: Chart timeframe the zone detection runs on: 5, 15, 60, 240 (4h), or 1440 (daily) minutes.

zoneType.description: fvg_bull/fvg_bear = 3-candle fair value gap (imbalance). ob_bull/ob_bear = last opposite-close candle before a displacement bar (order block).

a.description: First input — a primitive operand (price, indicator, or constant). No nesting.

b.description: Second input — a primitive operand (price, indicator, or constant). No nesting.

fn.description: spread = a - b (same units as inputs). ratio = a / b (fails when b is 0). abs_distance_pct = |a - b| / |b| * 100 (percent points — same scale as ATR_PCT and SL/TP).

op.description: Comparison operator. crosses_above/crosses_below require previous bar context.

endUtc.description: Window end, exclusive. Earlier than startUtc = overnight window (e.g. "02:00" with start "22:00"). Equal to startUtc = always in window.

startUtc.description: Window start, inclusive (e.g. "09:30" for the New York killzone open).

timeframeMinutes.description: Chart timeframe whose latest closed bar provides the clock. Use 5 or 15 for killzone precision.

days.description: Allowed UTC weekdays (e.g. omit "fri" to skip Friday).

timeframeMinutes.description: Chart timeframe whose latest closed bar provides the clock. Use 5 or 15 for precision.

strategy_id.description: Strategy id. Prefer always: routes to that Lab tab, and NO_ACTIVE_LAB errors include a direct Lab URL to open.
